  • Exfiltration/external upload: not identified.

- Observed URLs are consistent with licenses, documentation, project/source repositories, Sphinx, MathJax/CDN, and similar benign contexts.

- No suspicious C2, webhook, raw IP, paste/drop-service upload evidence was found.

  • Staging/archive collection: no evidence of malicious archive creation or temporary staging of harvested files.
  • Persistence: no evidence of systemd units, cron jobs, launch agents, shell-profile edits, background polling loops, or similar persistence.
  • Lateral movement: no evidence involving Kubernetes, Docker socket access, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions workflow injection, or CI token-reuse attacks.
  • Stealth/loaders:
